versions.webuiMismatchTitle: WebUI and AstrBot versions do not match
versions.webuiMismatchMessage: The current WebUI may have been built for another AstrBot version, so some pages or API calls may not work. First restart AstrBot manually. If the problem persists, delete data/dist in the working directory and restart AstrBot to download a compatible WebUI.
versions.runtimeMismatchTitle: Running AstrBot and code versions do not match
versions.runtimeMismatchMessage: The code has been updated, but the current process is still running an older version. Restart AstrBot manually to load the new code.
